# node-crowdsec

> Node.js client for the CrowdSec Local API (LAPI): bouncer/watcher client, HTTP middleware, detection scenarios and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Node.js 24 or newer.

All links point to raw Markdown so an agent can read them directly. The GitHub
wiki is for humans only and is intentionally not indexed here.

## Project

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/readme.md): overview, features and package list.
- [API compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/docs/api-compatibility.md): LAPI version matrix, failure modes, probes and fallbacks.
- [Architecture and threat model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/docs/architecture.md): components, data flows, security assessment.
- [Agent setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/docs/agent-setup-guide.md): configure the HTTP middleware with an agent.

## crowdsec-client

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/packages/crowdsec-client/README.md): install, compatibility, capability detection, type overrides.
- [API reference](https://thib3113.github.io/node-crowdsec/): generated Typedoc HTML.

## crowdsec-http-middleware

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/packages/crowdsec-http-middleware/readme.md): install, options, debug.
- [Scenarios README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/packages/crowdsec-client-scenarios/readme.md): scenario options used by the middleware.
- [Agent setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/docs/agent-setup-guide.md): interview-style configuration.

## crowdsec-client-scenarios

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/packages/crowdsec-client-scenarios/readme.md): `XForwardedForChecker`, `AllowListEnricher`, `HTTPEnricher`, `MaxMindEnricher`.

## crowdsec-mcp

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/packages/crowdsec-mcp/README.md): install, environment variables, CLI, tools, limits.
- [API compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/docs/api-compatibility.md): version-gated filters and write/delete asymmetry.
- [Docker Hub description](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/packages/crowdsec-mcp/DOCKERHUB.md): image usage.

## Examples

- [express-bouncer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/examples/express-bouncer/readme.md): Express + bouncer (TypeScript, ESM).
- [express-bouncer-cjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/examples/express-bouncer-cjs/readme.md): the same example in CommonJS.
- [express-web-parser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/main/examples/express-web-parser/readme.md): watcher that reports bad user-agents.
